title-group.article-title: Antimicrobial activity of nisin against Listeria monocytogenes in broth microdilution assay

abstract.p: In a broth microdilution assay, 10^6 CFU/mL Listeria monocytogenes in BHI broth was exposed to nisin at 2.5 mg/L.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Bacteriocins are antimicrobial peptides produced by bacteria. Nisin is a prominent lantibiotic.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: The MIC of nisin was 2.5 mg/L at pH 6.5. Exposure for 90 minutes resulted in complete inhibition.

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: These findings demonstrate potent antimicrobial efficacy of nisin against foodborne pathogens.
